import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import svd, eigvals
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
threadpool_limits(4)
np.set_printoptions(precision=3, suppress=True, linewidth=180)

def weights(l,j):
    s=slice(64*j,64*j+64)
    g=W[f"ln1_w.{l}"].astype(float)
    q=W[f"W_q.{l}"][s].astype(float)*g
    k=W[f"W_k.{l}"][s].astype(float)*g
    v=W[f"W_v.{l}"][s].astype(float)*g
    q-=q.mean(1,keepdims=True); k-=k.mean(1,keepdims=True); v-=v.mean(1,keepdims=True)
    o=W[f"W_o.{l}"][:,s].astype(float)
    return q,k,v,o

A=[]; B=[]
for l in range(4):
    for j in range(6):
        q,k,v,o=weights(l,j)
        A.append(q.T@k/8)
        B.append(o@v)

print("First-layer QK spectra and query/key alignment:")
for j in range(6):
    q,k,v,o=weights(0,j)
    u,s,vt=svd(A[j],full_matrices=False)
    ev=eigvals(A[j])
    ev=ev[np.argsort(-np.abs(ev))]
    print("\nL0H",j)
    print("QK singular values:",s[:45])
    print("QK eigenvalues:",ev[:30])
    print("Q,K singular values:",svd(q,compute_uv=False)[:16],svd(k,compute_uv=False)[:16])
    print("paired left/right singular-vector cosines:",np.diag(vt[:24]@u[:,:24]))
    print("OV eigenvalues:",eigvals(v@o)[np.argsort(-np.abs(eigvals(v@o)))][:16])

print("\nCosines among all QK matrices (6x6 layer blocks):")
for l in range(4):
    aa=np.stack([a.ravel() for a in A[6*l:6*l+6]])
    aa/=np.linalg.norm(aa,axis=1,keepdims=True)
    print("layer",l, "\n",aa@aa.T)

print("\nCross-head linear composition diagnostics: receiver QK @ earlier OV.")
print("For each receiver: largest normalized composition and largest signed trace, with source.")
for t in range(6,24):
    vals=[]
    for s in range((t//6)*6):
        c=A[t]@B[s]
        denom=np.linalg.norm(A[t])*np.linalg.norm(B[s])
        vals.append((s,np.linalg.norm(c)/denom,np.trace(c)/denom))
    print(f"L{t//6}H{t%6}",
          "norm",[(f"L{s//6}H{s%6}",round(n,4),round(tr,4)) for s,n,tr in sorted(vals,key=lambda z:-z[1])[:4]],
          "positive trace",[(f"L{s//6}H{s%6}",round(tr,4)) for s,n,tr in sorted(vals,key=lambda z:-z[2])[:3]])

print("\nLargest LayerNorm coordinates:")
for l in range(4):
    for name in ["ln1_w","ln1_b","ln2_w","ln2_b"]:
        a=W[f"{name}.{l}"]
        idx=np.argsort(-np.abs(a))[:10]
        print(l,name,list(zip(idx.tolist(),np.round(a[idx],4).tolist())))

import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import svd, eigvals
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
threadpool_limits(4)
np.set_printoptions(precision=3, suppress=True, linewidth=180)

print("Detailed spectra: counts of strongly represented directions")
for l in range(4):
    for name in ["W_fc","W_proj"]:
        s=svd(W[f"{name}.{l}"].astype(float),compute_uv=False)
        print(name,l,"first 65:",s[:65])

g0=W["ln1_w.0"].astype(float)
def effective(name,l):
    a=W[f"{name}.{l}"].astype(float)*W[f"ln1_w.{l}"].astype(float)
    return a-a.mean(1,keepdims=True)
qs=[effective("W_q",l) for l in range(4)]
ks=[effective("W_k",l) for l in range(4)]
vs=[effective("W_v",l) for l in range(4)]
As=[]; Bs=[]
for l in range(4):
    for j in range(6):
        s=slice(64*j,64*j+64)
        As.append(qs[l][s].T@ks[l][s]/8)
        Bs.append(W[f"W_o.{l}"][:,s].astype(float)@vs[l][s])

# These are subspaces of weight matrices, not network activations.
poscand=np.concatenate([qs[0][192:256],ks[0][192:256]],axis=0)
_,ss,vt=svd(poscand,full_matrices=False)
P=vt[:32].T
f=W["W_fc.0"].astype(float)*W["ln2_w.0"].astype(float)
f-=f.mean(1,keepdims=True)
_,sf,vf=svd(f,full_matrices=False)
T=vf[:28].T
print("\nCandidate weight-subspace overlaps:")
print("singular values of L0H3 Q/K stack:",ss[:60])
print("overlap of L0 MLP top28 and L0H3 Q/K top32:",svd(T.T@P,compute_uv=False))
for h in range(24):
    l,j=divmod(h,6); s=slice(64*j,64*j+64)
    a=As[h]; b=Bs[h]
    q,k=qs[l][s],ks[l][s]
    print(f"L{l}H{j}", "Q,K energy fractions in L0H3 subspace:",
          round(np.linalg.norm(q@P)**2/np.linalg.norm(q)**2,3),
          round(np.linalg.norm(k@P)**2/np.linalg.norm(k)**2,3),
          "Q,K energy fractions in L0MLP subspace:",
          round(np.linalg.norm(q@T)**2/np.linalg.norm(q)**2,3),
          round(np.linalg.norm(k@T)**2/np.linalg.norm(k)**2,3))

print("\nL0H3 -> later QK composition spectra:")
for h in range(6,24):
    c=As[h]@Bs[3]
    ev=eigvals(c)
    ix=np.argsort(-np.abs(ev))
    print(f"L{h//6}H{h%6}", "norm,trace,trace/sumabsEig:",
          round(np.linalg.norm(c),3),round(np.trace(c),3),
          round(np.trace(c)/(np.abs(ev).sum()+1e-12),3),
          "top eigenvalues:",ev[ix[:6]])

print("\nCross-layer positive-copy / negative-copy OV eigenvalue mass:")
for h,b in enumerate(Bs):
    l,j=divmod(h,6); s=slice(64*j,64*j+64)
    ev=eigvals(vs[l][s]@W[f"W_o.{l}"][:,s].astype(float))
    print(f"L{l}H{j}",ev[np.argsort(-np.abs(ev))[:8]])

import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import svd
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
threadpool_limits(4)
np.set_printoptions(precision=3,suppress=True,linewidth=180)

def eff(a,g):
    a=a.astype(float)*g.astype(float)
    return a-a.mean(1,keepdims=True)

q0=eff(W["W_q.0"],W["ln1_w.0"])
k0=eff(W["W_k.0"],W["ln1_w.0"])
v0=eff(W["W_v.0"],W["ln1_w.0"])
F=eff(W["W_fc.0"],W["ln2_w.0"])
s3=slice(192,256)
u,sv,vt=svd(v0[s3],full_matrices=False)
uo,so,vto=svd(W["W_o.0"][:,s3].astype(float),full_matrices=False)
print("L0H3 value singular values:",sv)
print("L0H3 output singular values:",so)
print("Value-input/output top24 subspace overlap:",svd(vt[:24]@uo[:,:24],compute_uv=False))

print("\nFirst-layer OV principal directions:")
for j in range(6):
    sl=slice(j*64,(j+1)*64)
    b=W["W_o.0"][:,sl].astype(float)@v0[sl]
    uu,ss,vv=svd(b,full_matrices=False)
    for z in range(2):
        idx=np.argsort(-np.abs(uu[:,z]))[:8]
        ix=np.argsort(-np.abs(vv[z]))[:5]
        print(f"H{j} mode{z} s={ss[z]:.3f}",
              "output coordinates",[(int(i),round(uu[i,z],3)) for i in idx],
              "input coordinates",[(int(i),round(vv[z,i],3)) for i in ix])

# Project neuron weight rows onto the main value-read and value-write subspaces.
R=vt[:28].T
S=uo[:,:28]
X=F@R
Y=F@S
print("\nNeuron weight projections: input-read and output-write subspaces.")
print("Energy fractions",np.linalg.norm(X)**2/np.linalg.norm(F)**2,np.linalg.norm(Y)**2/np.linalg.norm(F)**2)
for label,Z in [("read",X),("write",Y)]:
    Z=Z-Z.mean(0)
    Z=Z/np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(Z,axis=1,keepdims=True),1e-12)
    for nc in [18,22,26,28,32]:
        km=KMeans(n_clusters=nc,n_init=10,random_state=7).fit(Z)
        sil=silhouette_score(Z,km.labels_,sample_size=1000,random_state=7)
        counts=np.bincount(km.labels_,minlength=nc)
        print(label,"clusters",nc,"silhouette",round(sil,3),"sizes",np.sort(counts)[::-1])

# Affine QK coefficients: no LayerNorm or attention is evaluated.
print("\nQK key-only affine term and positional-weight coupling:")
Bs=[]
for j in [1,2,4,5]:
    sl=slice(64*j,64*j+64)
    Bs.append(W["W_o.0"][:,sl].astype(float)@v0[sl])
U,_,_=svd(np.concatenate(Bs,axis=1),full_matrices=False)
C=U[:,:4]
for l in range(4):
    g=W[f"ln1_w.{l}"]; b=W[f"ln1_b.{l}"].astype(float)
    for j in range(6):
        sl=slice(64*j,64*j+64)
        qr=W[f"W_q.{l}"][sl].astype(float)
        q=eff(qr,g)
        k=eff(W[f"W_k.{l}"][sl],g)
        A=q.T@k/8
        t=k.T@(qr@b)/8
        print(f"L{l}H{j}","key-linear norm",round(np.linalg.norm(t),3),
              "key-linear along shared4",np.round(C.T@t,3),
              "QK key-energy in shared4",round(np.linalg.norm(A@C)**2/np.linalg.norm(A)**2,3),
              "QK query-energy in shared4",round(np.linalg.norm(C.T@A)**2/np.linalg.norm(A)**2,3))

    Y=coefficients[:,rank:]
    X-=X.mean(0); Y-=Y.mean(0)
    cx=X.T@X; cy=Y.T@Y
